feature_flags.name: enableParticipantArea

behavior_when_false.routes: Participant routes (/connexion, /inscription, /participant/**) are excluded from routing table
behavior_when_false.user_experience: Users see a 404 redirect to home if they try to access participant URLs

behavior_when_true.routes: All participant routes become available and matched by canMatch guard

production.source: defaults to false; can be overridden via Vercel env vars on kraak-consulting project
production.intent: Participant area is hidden in prod until approved post-MVP

staging.source: Vercel preview override for staging branch
staging.intent: Enable for testing on staging branch preview

feature_flags.temporary_status: This flag is TEMPORARY and will be removed post-MVP once participant area passes security review. See ARC-10 decision document.
feature_flags.removal_plan: Post-MVP: Remove flag from runtime-config, collapse buildRoutes to constant, remove @if in navbar, clean env files, remove Vercel variable

runtime_configuration.loaded_at: SSR time (main.server.ts) and client time (runtime-config.js asset)

lms.description: Course/module/lesson/quiz structure, progress tracking, PDF certification

documents.evidence: No document management endpoints or mobile/web pages

cms.description: Editorial workflows, publishing roles, multi-version content

crm.description: Profile enrichment, participant view, scoring, email sequences
crm.evidence: No CRM features; AUT and contact form exist but no advanced scoring/automation

advanced_push_notifications.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging setup exists but labeled as 'Souhaitée' (nice-to-have) in mobile MVP, not Indispensable
advanced_push_notifications.note: Basic prep done; production rollout deferred to V1.1+

incomplete_or_draft_status.summary: All MVP vitrine pages are COMPLETE. All participant area features are IMPLEMENTED but HIDDEN behind feature flag (not MVP scope). No explicit WIP/TODO/draft comments found in source code.
notable_patterns: Announcements include 'custom' audience type in enum but MVP only supports all_participants/program/cohort - 'custom' is V1.1+ reserved
Status enums include 'draft' for programs, cohorts, resources, announcements - these support draft/published/archived statuses but no admin CMS to manage drafts

Mobile MVP specified 'Indispensable' vs 'Souhaitée' classifications per mobile_mvp.md; all Indispensable features are implemented; Souhaitée features (push notifications, profile, progress markers) are partially prepared

files_describing_v11_scope: docs/specs/BACKLOG.md - Section 'Phase V1.1 - Hors MVP' lists all V1.1 epics and milestones
AGENTS.md - Section 'Hors MVP (V1.1+)' lists features explicitly excluded from MVP
docs/decisions/ARC-05-criteres-anti-scope-creep.md - Table of excluded features and rationale
docs/decisions/ARC-10-feature-flag-participant-area.md - Details on participant area feature flag (temporary, post-MVP removal planned)

structure_observations.web_routes: apps/client/projects/web/src/app/app.routes.ts uses buildMarketingRoute() factory and buildRoutes() function that dynamically includes participantAreaRoutes based on isParticipantAreaEnabled()
structure_observations.mobile_routes: apps/client/projects/mobile/src/app/app.routes.ts has fixed routes with guards; MOBILE_SHELL_CHILD_ROUTES from mobile-shell.config.ts defines tabbed navigation
structure_observations.api_modules: apps/api/src/ contains: AuthModule, DashboardModule, ProgramsModule, ResourcesModule, AnnouncementsModule, SupportModule - all functional
structure_observations.contracts: packages/contracts/ defines all DTOs and enums; packages/domain/ contains validation logic and status transition rules

code_patterns_found: ProgramAnnouncementPreviewDto - Used in dashboard and program detail to show limited announcement info

Status enums: PublicationStatus (draft/published/archived), CohortStatus (draft/open/active/completed/archived), SessionStatus, EnrollmentStatus - all support draft state but no editorial workflow implemented
Access control: Dashboard and participant endpoints all require bearer token; resourceRLS on Supabase ensures data isolation
Partial types: UpdateXxxDto types are Partial<CreateXxxDto> enabling PATCH operations, but no PUT/PATCH endpoints implemented (only GET/POST for now)

deployment_status.staging: enableParticipantArea = true (participant area visible on preview)

recommendations.documentation: This inventory documents completed participant area features not visible in production. Post-MVP, consider: (1) Update this file when V1.1 work begins, (2) Remove feature flag once security/privacy review passes, (3) Retire V1.1 backlog references and consolidate into primary backlog
recommendations.testing: All participant area pages and endpoints are covered by Playwright E2E (QAT-04) and unit tests. Coverage: 88+ suites, 1060+ tests, all passing.
recommendations.cleanup: After MVP pilot completion and decision to proceed with participant area: (1) Collapse buildRoutes to constant routes, (2) Remove participantAreaCanMatch guard, (3) Remove @if (participantAreaEnabled) from navbar, (4) Remove .env CLIENT_FEATURE_PARTICIPANT_AREA variables, (5) Deprecate runtime-config usage for this flag
